limitations: Only finite host-only toy Python processes; no gem5, RandomX, dataset initialization or scientific validation.
Actual fixture resource overrides are deliberately tiny; manifest retains unmodified production baseline and must not be mistaken for observed fixture limits.
Session independence means the launching subprocess/session exited while systemd-owned service/log progress continued; no active Codex daemon termination or physical reboot is performed.
Prior independently accepted final988 >45s finalizer-delay fixture remains separate evidence; this replay keeps its ExecStopPost private CLI unchanged and exercises normal finalization.
Fixture initializes only its new isolated INVENTORY root, never the production root or migration state; expensive-work admission and scientific acceptance remain unverified.
Whole replay is single-use. Existing partial root/evidence prevents repetition; preserve every outcome and inspect/recover individual execution IDs without clearing request claims.

Runner serializes payloads and drains workload descendants. A transient empty-cgroup gap between worker exit and private finalizer startup means prior FINALIZED ordering is observed in this replay, not a formal admission guarantee. The strict observation is retained; a mismatch is recorded as a failed fixture, not silently accepted.
v2_scope: Wait for actual heartbeat logs rather than assuming ready.json means first print happened.
Check manager returncode/known states and fail closed on terminal state missing requested evidence; healthy wait remains unbounded.
Recheck evidence after manager query to avoid read/query observation race.
v3_scope: Failure cleanup enumerates every new isolated execution, validates exact ID/unit/fixed-request/root/release binding, and records partial/malformed entries.
Cleanup stops exact derived units through systemd and records it externally; it does not append potentially late execution events or clear claims.
Accepted receipt requires unchanged externally approved plan binding before execution and at final publication.
Strict first-FINALIZED before second-CHILD_STARTED remains required empirical observation; it is not claimed as a formal guarantee of the runner.
